calculation_handling.description: Waste and recyclable material must be stored in a wholly enclosed building if the school was built under a permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: Permit dates and waste storage are not modelled.

units.disclosure: The waste storage enclosure rule for newer schools is not evaluated.

150.48.150.1(1).explanation: All waste and recyclable material must be stored in a wholly enclosed building if a public or private school was built under a permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013.
